description: A dreamlike fusion where luminous celestial figures drift through crumbling gothic arches overgrown with luminous bioluminescent flora, their translucent robes dissolving into swirling cosmic nebulae and ancient runes that hover above mirror-like waters reflecting both starlit voids and sun-dappled forest canopies. Ethereal hands emerge from swirling mists, weaving threads of liquid starlight through floating petals and broken marble statues reclaimed by nature, while distant floating islands adorned with glowing lanterns hover beneath twin moons and a radiant solar eclipse. The entire scene breathes with quiet mysticism as time itself seems suspended between decay and rebirth.
